summary: Isabella Bank Corporation filed an 8-K on August 27, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared a third-quarter cash dividend of $0.28 per common share. The dividend is payable September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 28, 2026. This is a routine quarterly dividend declaration, not a special-situation event such as a capital return program, tender offer, or strategic action. The filing includes the press release as Exhibit 99.1. There are no unusual terms, premiums, or structural elements. No advisors, recommendations, or regulatory milestones are mentioned. This is an ordinary operational announcement with no special-situation characteristics; the appropriate classification is None.
